Adoption.title: Adoption Form
Adoption.subtitle: Complete this form to start the adoption process
Adoption.heroSubtitle: Give them a forever home and change a life forever
Adoption.whatIsTitle: What does it mean to adopt a greyhound?
Adoption.whatIsDescription: Adopting a greyhound is a lifelong commitment of love. It means giving them a forever home, covering all their needs, and becoming their family for life. It's a wonderful decision that will change both your life and that of the greyhound you adopt.
Adoption.whatIsBenefit1: Lifelong commitment to your new companion
Adoption.whatIsBenefit2: Full responsibility for their wellbeing and health
Adoption.whatIsBenefit3: Change a life forever and gain a loyal friend
Adoption.whatIsBenefit4: Support and follow-up from the association
Adoption.requirementsSubtitle: Make sure you meet these requirements before applying for adoption
Adoption.req1Description: Must be over 18 years old and have legal capacity to adopt
Adoption.req2Description: Adequate home with sufficient space and permission to have pets
Adoption.req3Description: Availability to dedicate time to walks, play, and daily care
Adoption.req4Description: Ability to cover veterinary expenses, food, and care
Adoption.req5Description: Willingness to care for the greyhound throughout their life (10-15 years)
Adoption.req6Description: All family members must agree with the adoption
Adoption.processSubtitle: We accompany you every step of the way to adoption
Adoption.step1Description: Complete the form with your details and tell us about your home and lifestyle
Adoption.step2Description: We get to know each other better through a phone or in-person interview
Adoption.step3Description: We visit your home to ensure it's suitable for the greyhound
Adoption.step4Description: We introduce you to the greyhound that best fits your family and lifestyle
Adoption.step5Description: We support you during the first months and are available for any questions
Adoption.faqSubtitle: We answer the most common questions about adoption
Adoption.faq1Question: How much does it cost to adopt a greyhound?
Adoption.faq1Answer: Adoption costs €150 which includes: sterilization, microchip, vaccines, deworming, disease testing, and veterinary follow-up. This cost covers only part of the actual expenses for each dog.
Adoption.faq2Answer: Includes: sterilized greyhound, microchipped, vaccinated, dewormed, disease-tested, complete veterinary record, adoption contract, post-adoption follow-up, and permanent advice from the association.
Adoption.faq3Question: Can I return the greyhound if it doesn't work out?
Adoption.faq3Answer: Adoption is a lifelong commitment. However, if serious unforeseen problems arise, the association takes charge of the greyhound to find them a new home. We never accept returns due to whim or lack of commitment.
Adoption.faq4Question: Do greyhounds get along well with children and other pets?
Adoption.faq4Answer: Yes, most greyhounds adapt very well to families with children and other pets. Each greyhound is evaluated individually and we'll recommend the one that best suits your family situation.
Adoption.faq5Question: Do greyhounds need a lot of exercise?
Adoption.faq5Answer: Contrary to belief, greyhounds are calm dogs that enjoy 2-3 moderate daily walks. They are true 'couch potatoes' and adapt well to apartment living.
Adoption.faq6Question: How long does the adoption process take?
Adoption.faq6Answer: The process usually takes 2-4 weeks from application to adoption, depending on availability for visits and interviews. We want to ensure it's a good decision for everyone.

hero.title: Become a Volunteer!
hero.subtitle: Dedicate your time to help greyhounds and change their lives
hero.description: Somos Galgos is a non-profit organization that depends on committed volunteers. Your help is essential to continue rescuing, caring for, and finding homes for hundreds of greyhounds every year.

whatIs.title: What does it mean to be a volunteer?
whatIs.description: Being a volunteer at Somos Galgos means dedicating your time and energy to helping at the shelter. You can participate in different activities according to your skills and interests: walks with greyhounds, socialization, administrative help, events, or even being a temporary foster family.
whatIs.impact: Your contribution is vital. Every hour you dedicate directly helps improve the quality of life of the greyhounds and speeds up their adoption process.

flexibility.title: Flexibility
flexibility.description: Choose when and how much time you can dedicate. It doesn't have to be every day, you can collaborate according to your availability.

community.title: Community
community.description: Join a team of people passionate about animals. Share experiences and enjoy a committed community.

benefit1.title: Meaningful Help
benefit1.description: Your direct work helps save lives and change the future of rescued greyhounds.

benefit2.title: Special Connection
benefit2.description: You will experience a unique and deep connection with the animals, you will witness their transformation and recovery.

benefit3.title: Personal Growth
benefit3.description: Develop new skills, expand your network of friends, and contribute to a meaningful cause.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: What are the requirements to be a volunteer?
faq.answer1: You only need to be 18 years old, have availability, and a passion for helping. No previous experience with animals is necessary.
faq.question2: How much time do I need to dedicate?
faq.answer2: It depends on you. You can dedicate from a few hours a week to several days. We ask that you commit to a minimum of one shift per week.
faq.question3: What type of tasks can I do?
faq.answer3: There are many options: walks with greyhounds, socialization, help with events, administrative tasks, facility cleaning, or being a temporary foster family.
faq.question4: Do I need previous experience with dogs?
faq.answer4: No, it's not necessary. We will provide you with all the training you need. You just need the desire to learn and a love for animals.

Sponsorship.formSubtitle: Complete this form to sponsor one of our greyhounds
Sponsorship.heroSubtitle: Help financially a greyhound and receive updates about their life
Sponsorship.whatTitle: What does it mean to sponsor a greyhound?
Sponsorship.whatDescription1: Sponsoring is a flexible way to help rescued greyhounds without the commitment of permanent adoption. Your monthly fee directly helps cover veterinary expenses, food, and care.
Sponsorship.whatDescription2: As a sponsor, you will receive periodic updates about the greyhound you sponsor, photos and news about their progress.
Sponsorship.whatDescription3: It's the perfect way to make a difference in a greyhound's life if you can't adopt or foster, but want to help consistently.
Sponsorship.whatDescription4: Every contribution, no matter how small, is fundamental to keeping our rescue and protection programs running.
Sponsorship.benefit1Desc: Receive exclusive photos and updates of the greyhound you sponsor
Sponsorship.benefit2Desc: Maintain a meaningful connection with your sponsored greyhound
Sponsorship.benefit3Desc: Your fee covers veterinary expenses and direct care costs
Sponsorship.benefit4Desc: Join our sponsors and become part of a special community
Sponsorship.faq1Question: What is the minimum fee to sponsor?
Sponsorship.faq1Answer: The minimum fee is €10 per month. You can contribute more if you wish. We accept monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual payments.
Sponsorship.faq2Question: What does my sponsorship fee include?
Sponsorship.faq2Answer: Your fee covers: food, veterinary expenses, medicines, insurance, facility maintenance, and dedicated staff for the greyhound's care.
Sponsorship.faq3Question: Will I receive updates about my sponsored greyhound?
Sponsorship.faq3Answer: Yes, you will receive monthly updates with photos and news about your sponsored greyhound. You also have access to our exclusive newsletter.
Sponsorship.faq4Question: Can I change which greyhound I'm sponsoring?
Sponsorship.faq4Answer: If your greyhound finds an adoptive home, you can transfer your sponsorship to another greyhound in need. This depends on whether you accept automatic transfers.

Member.formSubtitle: Complete this form to become a member of Somos Galgos
Member.heroSubtitle: Join our association and support the greyhound cause continuously
Member.heroCTA: I Want to be a Member
Member.whatTitle: What does it mean to be a member?
Member.whatDescription1: Being a member means being an active part of our association, continuously supporting our work in rescue, protection and adoption of greyhounds.
Member.whatDescription2: As a member, you contribute financially to keep our projects running and help cover the general expenses of the association.
Member.whatDescription3: Unlike sponsorship, your contribution is not linked to a specific greyhound, but supports the overall functioning of the organization.
Member.whatDescription4: Every member is fundamental for us to continue our mission and rescue more greyhounds in need.
Member.benefit1Desc: Your fee supports all our projects and rescue programs
Member.benefit2Desc: Right to participate in assemblies and important decisions
Member.benefit3Desc: Receive privileged information about our activities
Member.benefit4Desc: Be part of a network of people committed to the cause
Member.faq1Answer: The minimum fee is €10 per month. You can contribute more if you wish. We accept monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual payments.
Member.faq2Question: How is my membership fee used?
Member.faq2Answer: Your fee is used to cover the general expenses of the association: veterinary care, facilities, food for all greyhounds, staff, awareness campaigns, and any urgent needs that arise.
Member.faq3Question: Do I have any rights as a member?
Member.faq3Answer: Yes, as a member you have the right to attend general assemblies, participate in voting on important decisions, and be informed about all association activities.
Member.faq4Question: Can I change from member to sponsor?
Member.faq4Answer: Of course. You can modify your type of collaboration at any time by contacting us. You can also be both a member and a sponsor at the same time.
